Subject: Draft MAP: Security review & SOC 2 evidence schedule (Acme Cloud)

Hi Laura / Matt —

Thanks again for the time this morning. As promised, attaching a first-pass MAP (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) that captures the milestones we discussed on the call and the security milestone in more detail. Key highlights below and a couple of asks to keep momentum: 

1) High-level target: close commercial deal by 2026-06-30 (target close).

2) Security milestone (critical path):
   - SOC 2 questionnaire responses (owner: Acme security) — proposed due: 2026-05-17
   - Evidence inventory (owner: Acme + Redwood evidence lead) — proposed due: 2026-05-21
   - Evidence delivery (phased) — Redwood to receive first tranche by 2026-05-28, final tranche by 2026-06-11

3) Other milestones & owners:
   - Contract review & legal redlines (owner: Acme legal / Redwood legal) — review window 2026-05-25 to 2026-06-08
   - Dedicated onboarding checklist (owner: marissa_cole) — readiness review 2026-06-15

Dependencies / open items:
- Confirmation of the primary security contact at Acme for questionnaire/evidence coordination
- Preferred secure upload mechanism for sensitive artifacts (S3 presigned / Box / Secure Share)
- Any regulatory evidence types beyond standard SOC 2 (e.g., encryption attestations, KMS/HSM proof)

Asks (please reply inline):
- Confirm owners for the security milestone and accept or suggest alternate due dates
- If you can provide the security contact, we will share an evidence inventory template to accelerate collection
- Are there any internal blackout dates in late May we should avoid for reviews?

Scheduling: propose a 30-min follow-up for Tue May 18 to review the completed questionnaire and confirm evidence handoff plan. I'll send a calendar invite once we lock owners/dates.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestones); redwood-msaref-DF-2026.pdf (reference MSA excerpt for procurement)

Thanks—

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the clear recap and the MAP draft. A few quick notes from our side: 

- I'll loop in our security lead Matt Price (matt.price@acme.com) who will be the primary owner for the SOC 2 questionnaire and evidence collection. Adding him to this thread.
- Our procurement team is constrained this month; legal will not begin negotiating redlines until May 25. We can still aim for the June 30 close, but legal/PO signing may push to early July if redlines take longer.
- On the dates: questionnaire by 2026-05-17 is tight for us. Can we move that to 2026-05-20? That gives Matt and his team a couple extra days. Evidence inventory by 2026-05-24 seems reasonable.
- For secure upload: we prefer pre-signed S3 links or our Box instance. If Redwood can provide a pre-signed S3 workflow or a secure Share link, that works best. Please avoid email attachments for anything labeled "PII" or encryption keys.

Matt — can you confirm you can drive the questionnaire and share any internal blockers?

Laura Chen

Looping in a brief internal note so we can be ready once Acme confirms owners/approach.

Jonas / team — I can take ownership on the Redwood side for collecting evidence and preparing the bundle that maps to the SOC 2 questions. Proposed internal plan: 

- Share SOC2-evidence-inventory-template.csv with Acme (template attached) so they can indicate which artifacts exist and who will upload them.
- Offer two secure upload mechanisms: (A) pre-signed S3 PUT links (we'll provide a short-lived bucket path) or (B) a Box shared folder with restricted access. I recommend S3 for larger artifacts, Box for ongoing collaboration.
- Once inventory is populated, I'll coordinate a 1-hour evidence walkthrough with Acme to confirm items and note any gaps (target: within 3 business days of inventory receipt).

I will also prepare a minimal evidence checklist for common items we typically need:
- System architecture diagram w/ network boundaries
- Access control lists and admin roster (timestamped)
- Encryption at rest/in transit attestation (KMS info)
- Change management ticket examples and patch schedule
- Backup & retention policy excerpts
